data.summary_en: VEPA represents LLM agent guardrails as formal executable symbolic-rule policies; deployment feedback guides LLM-proposed policy patches; a deterministic verifier accepts only structurally valid, conflict-free policies; an evidence-aware authorization layer activates them, outperforming baselines on ASSEBench-Safety, ASSEBench-Security, and ATBench and extending deterministic formal policy enforcement.
